name: How long does it take to close on an off-market waterfront home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to close on an off-market waterfront home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The closing timeline for an off-market waterfront home can vary, much like a traditional sale, typically ranging from 30 to 60 days once an offer is accepted. However, because these transactions often involve discerning buyers and sellers, the negotiation and due diligence periods can sometimes be more flexible or expedited depending on mutual agreement. An experienced agent can help manage expectations and facilitate a smooth, efficient closing process for properties in communities like Pinecrest or Sunny Isles Beach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Closing typically takes 30-60 days, similar to traditional sales. The timeline can be flexible depending on buyer-seller agreement and due diligence requirements.
